items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: most favorite spot to jam was around Nellie Lutchers house... She lived right around the corner on old 40th Street from the Downbeat. And she was some kind of piano player.

ctx.x: Yeah I know, between Santa Barbara and Vernon I think they added a street and changed the numbers.
Uh-huh. We just jammed everywhere we could find to jam -- that's you know -- oh, most favorite spot to jam was around Nellie Lutchers house.
